slice.scope: One bounded static-artifact audit of the committed results package and its direct producer path; no benchmark execution.
observations: The immutable tree contains results/experiment_results.json (blob 80e927c9c37e8e50d73895dbf75201f878bae0d4), result_summary.md (blob 8965b43a652205358f9c83544d49d79d18d3cd68), run_all_experiments.py (blob 432b876dff3fc900125ed3f34d0555421b696ce8), source audit_protocol/transparency_log.py, and tests, but no committed transparency-log/replay event ledger or per-trial replay-vector file surfaced in the complete recursive tree.

results/experiment_results.json commits aggregate simulation/benchmark outputs plus a reproducibility block with profile, config path and SHA-256, fixed seed registry, sample sizes, runtime seconds, Python/OS/architecture, NumPy/SciPy versions, and a code SHA-256 manifest.
run_all_experiments.py loads the chosen JSON config, passes fixed seeds and sample sizes into the simulations/benchmark, generates figures, and writes the aggregate experiment_results JSON.

The checked producer does not emit a run_id, Git commit identity, timestamp, ordered per-trial realized inputs/outputs, verifier-decision ledger, transparency-log/replay transcript, or result_summary.md. A text search of the producer has no result_summary reference, so the committed summary is not producer-bound by this path.
slice.inference: This revision improves retrospective reproducibility because config, seeds, environment metadata, code hashes and aggregate outputs are committed together. It does not close static causal replay: realized random draws and ordered trial outputs would have to be regenerated by executing Python, publication-summary cells are not bound to an explicit committed reducer from the checked producer, and no same-run execution identity or committed transparency/replay ledger binds the aggregate JSON to an actual execution.
